title: Chasing rotational symmetry in the spectre tiling
summary: We identify the rotational symmetry centers in the spectre tiling. We find that both 2-fold and 3-fold symmetry centers are coexisting, with two different types of 3-fold centers. Local and global symmetry operations are distinguished, and characterized in terms of substitution systems. We introduce a decomposition of the spectre tiling in terms of three metatiles named diabolo, 2-arms and 3-arms, valid at any substitution level. We propose geometrical constructions for generating patches of the spectre tiling with 2-fold and 3-fold global rotational symmetry.
